summary: DEADLINE: Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Scholarships & Leadership Programme (Oxford master's, 2027-28)
description:
Eligibility: Graduates and early-career professionals from mainly low- and middle-income countries; must be admitted to an eligible 1-year Oxford master's course (no DPhil) and intend to return to their home country or region. Most scholars have 5+ years of work experience, but it is not required. Check Oxford's lists of eligible countries and courses.
Benefits: 100% of course fees, a living stipend (£21,805 in 2026-27) and a place on the Leadership Programme (about 200 hours, mid-September to early July).
Deadline: Set by the Oxford course: the January deadline or earlier (some courses close in December). The date shown is a typical January date, so check your course page.
Requirements: Select the scholarship on the Oxford graduate application form and submit the WHT application at the same time; English language test required.
Portal: https://whtrust.org/scholarship-application/

summary: DEADLINE: Caltech SURF (Summer Undergraduate Research)
description:
Focus: Research in any field offered at Caltech, including computing, AI and algorithms (placement depends on your mentor).
Eligibility: Continuing undergraduates, international students included. Caltech students need a GPA of 2.0+; visiting students need a cumulative GPA of 2.5/4.0+ and must be eligible for fall registration. JPL placements are limited to US citizens and permanent residents.
Benefits: 10-week fellowship starting mid-June with a flat stipend, about $8,110 in 2026. The 2027 amount and exactly what it covers are not confirmed here, so check the official page.
Requirements: A Caltech faculty mentor's agreement to supervise you, research proposal, unofficial transcript, 2 recommendation letters (at least one from a faculty member), online application.
Deadline: Applications open Nov 1, 2026; application and letters due Feb 22, 2027; awards announced Apr 1, 2027.
Portal: https://sfp.caltech.edu/undergraduate-research/programs/surf/application_information

summary: DEADLINE: Max Planck Institutes (CIS) Research Internship - Summer Start
description:
Focus: All areas of Computer Science (MPI for Informatics, MPI for Software Systems, MPI for Security and Privacy).
Deadline: Nov 1 is strict for internships starting May-Aug of the following year; decisions by Feb 1. Other start dates are rolling (apply at least 5 months ahead).
Eligibility: Bachelors, Masters and PhD students worldwide with roughly the first three years of a CS bachelors completed by the start, and an excellent academic record. Prior research experience is not required.
Benefits: Fully funded (stipend, housing, round-trip travel), typically 12-14 weeks.
Requirements: CV, transcripts (unofficial accepted), contact for at least 1 referee, optional motivation letter.
Note: MPI for Intelligent Systems is not part of this program; contact its faculty directly.
Portal: https://apply.cis.mpg.de/register/internship

summary: DEADLINE: Gates Foundation AI Fellow - Africa Regional Offices (12-month fellowship)

Location: Abuja (Nigeria), Addis Ababa (Ethiopia), Johannesburg (South Africa) or Nairobi (Kenya).
Focus: Apply AI to the Foundation's health, development and education priorities in low- and middle-income countries; each fellow is assigned 1-2 high-priority projects with the Africa team and partners.
Deadline: Apply by Nov 11, 2026 (the Workday listing closes Nov 12 EST).
Note: One-off call for the first Africa-based cohort. Pay for this cohort is not confirmed; the earlier global program listed about $148,920-$162,350 depending on location.
